verdicts.evidence: The right-hand panel has only the fields "Your name" and "Home landing" plus a Sign up button, and its helper text promises "one short note when the timetable changes" without any email or phone field.

The figure is made of flat rectangles (pale sky, light grey block, dark grey slab, pale blue water) plus a saturated blue rounded bar that matches the Sign up button's colour and shape, and it shows no ramps, waiting area or step-free boarding.
The panel reads "Get timetable changes" with a generic "Sign up" button, and "Home landing" is a plain empty text field rather than a picker.
